checks.name: checkpoint-integrity
checks.guarantee: Disclosed fields match signed ordered checkpoints; hidden fields are not checked

checks.name: request
checks.guarantee: Disclosed canonical request matches the approved request hash

checks.name: action-proof
checks.guarantee: Evidence checkpoint is cross-linked to exact registration/payment digests; it is not an on-chain session-root gate

checks.name: registration-and-authority
checks.guarantee: Exact transaction, session signature, owner scope, validity and budget checks at the registration block

checks.name: budget
checks.guarantee: Recomputed occupied funds include paid and unresolved commitments; released commitments are excluded

checks.name: payment
checks.guarantee: Actual payer, recipient, nonce and amount agree; delivery remains a separate check

checks.name: evidence-validation
checks.guarantee: Malformed, tampered or insufficient disclosed data is not accepted

limits: RPC data is trusted; two agreeing providers are not an independent consensus proof.
Session signatures authenticate claimed observations, not HTTPS source truth or a complete history.
The deployed wallet enforces request/quote hashes and financial scope, not the entire session root.
Merchant receipts do not sign payment amount, request body or result body.
